task.title: Open an Existing Working Copy
task.shortdesc: Point the Git Client at a Git repository that is already on your machine.

step.cmd:
In the view, open the
drop-down.
Select a recently used working copy, or choose Browse to locate a Git repository folder on disk.

result.p: The selected repository becomes the current working copy.
result.note: When you open a working copy, the Git Client checks for local branches whose remote branch was deleted and offers to remove them. You can turn this check off in the . See for details.
